summary: Structured-output final-chunk blocking under high concurrency causes long-tail inference latency
description:
Issue summary: Customers using structured JSON ("structured_output" mode) report large long-tail latencies (seconds to tens of seconds) when calling the streaming API under high concurrency. Impact: production traffic for a dedicated customer (NoteWave Labs) experienced 95th/99th percentile increases; real-time enrichment widgets timed out and degraded UX.

Environment: prod us-east (dedicated pool for NoteWave Labs). Occurs more often during traffic spikes (~500 concurrent streams). Models: rw-opt-13b-quantized primarily, but reproducible on open-7b-compat.

Steps to reproduce:
1) Configure a streaming chat request with structured_output enabled and a JSON schema that includes a final array field and optional trailing metadata field.
2) Send 400-600 concurrent streaming sessions with ~300 token generated responses each.
3) Observe that most requests stream tokens fine but a subset hangs for additional 5–30s waiting for the final chunk to arrive/parse.

Observed behavior: A fraction (~0.5–2%) of streams stall during finalization. Server-side logs show the model generating the final tokens and the runtime emitting final chunks, but the structured parser appears to block on stream termination/aggregate parsing. CPU on serving nodes shows short spikes on the parser thread; backlog on the runtime's completion queue increases. Requests eventually finish or time out at 30s.

Expected behavior: Streaming responses with structured_output should finalize within normal token latency bounds; the parser should incrementally validate/emit structured pieces without blocking other streams.

Customer impact: NoteWave Labs reported elevated error rates in their real-time UI; they were forced to route to a lower-fidelity non-structured mode as a workaround. Business impact is material for their product demos this week.

Temporary workaround: Disable structured_output or drop the final optional metadata field; reduce concurrency per client. Workaround reduces correctness guarantees for the customer but restores latency.
steps_to_reproduce: Enable structured_output with a schema containing a final array and optional metadata
Spawn 400-600 concurrent streaming requests against dedicated pool in us-east
Generate ~300 tokens per session and monitor stream completion times
Observe 95th/99th percentile long-tail delays and occasional 30s timeouts
logs_and_artifacts: 2026-03-13T14:12:08Z parser: stream-id=abc123 waiting on termination token, parsing stalled 12s
Node metrics: serving-node-7 cpu_parser_thread spike to 92% at 14:12:09Z
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: incremental parser is performing a blocking full-JSON validation on final chunk under certain buffer boundary conditions.
SRE observed parser CPU spikes correlated with backlog in completion queue; queuing increases latency for subsequent streams.
Customer reproduction: NoteWave confirmed stable repro when sending schemas with final arrays > 50 items and optional trailing metadata fields.
Able to reproduce locally with load generator; enabling single-threaded parser reduces contention but does not eliminate stalls (indicates pathological code path).
No evidence of model generation stalls; model emits tokens on expected schedule.
mitigation_and_next_steps: Short-term: recommend disabling structured_output for NoteWave's high-concurrency endpoints or simplify schema (remove large final arrays).
SRE will provision a temporary extra serving pool for NoteWave to lower per-node concurrency while fix is developed.
ENG to triage parser implementation: add incremental/streaming-validate path that avoids full-document blocking on final chunk parsing.
Add targeted unit/integration tests with concurrent streams and large final arrays to CI.
Target: hotfix to runtime parser in 72 hours, followed by a canary rollout to dedicated pools.
resolution_notes: (pending) Engineering assigned to implement non-blocking finalization for structured parser. Temporary pool and customer workaround applied on 2026-03-13 18:00Z.
